title: DJIA Market Happenings For Wednesday, January 17, 2018
text:
DJIA Market Happenings For Wednesday, January 17, 2018 Posted by admin on January 17th, 2018 
Dow stocks at 52 week highs include Apple (AAPL), American Express (AXP), Boeing (BA), Caterpillar (CAT), Cisco (CSCO), DowDupont (DWDP), Johnson & Johnson (JNJ), JPMorgan (JPM), 3M (MMM), Microsoft (MSFT), Nike (NKE), UnitedHealth (UNH), United Technologies (UTX) and Visa (V). There are no Dow stock 52 week lows. 
The Market 
Premarket today, the Dow was indicated to open up +96 points. 
Tuesday the Dow was down -10.33 (-0.04%) at 25,792.86. 
Year-to-date the Dow is up +4.34%. 
There were 12 Dow stocks up Tuesday. 
The Dow stock winners Tuesday were led by Merck (MRK) +5.81% and UnitedHealth (UNH) +1.86%. 
The Dow stock losers Tuesday were led by General Electric (GE) -2.93% and Nike (NKE) -1.93%. 
Most of today’s new highs closed lower which makes this look like a blow-off top. The VIX also closed up +14.76% at 11.66. 
International Business Machines (IBM +0.44%) was upgraded to ‘Overweight’ from ‘Underweight’ at Barclays with a price target of $192. 
European stocks are lower and Asian markets ended mostly higher. 
The national average price of gasoline is up four-tenths of a cent at $2.534 per gallon.
